Meryem Cennet Çal.scout_notu: Born in 2000, disciplined central midfielder Meryem Cal developed her tactical understanding and technical fundamentals through Germany's structured youth competitive system before transitioning into senior top-flight football. Operating predominantly as a deep-lying playmaker or central holding midfielder, she excels at controlling the tempo of the game through structured positioning and short possession recirculation. Because she possesses exceptional spatial awareness and composure under pressure, she effectively acts as an anchor in build-up play, safely connecting the defensive backline to the midfield under high pressing. Furthermore, her tactical discipline in defensive positioning enables her to screen central lanes efficiently, executing timely interceptions to disrupt opposition counter-attacks before they materialize. However, her progressive vertical passing output into the final third requires greater risk-taking and technical ambition, as she tends to favor lateral and safe backwards retention passes. Additionally, her dynamic movement during high-intensity box-to-box transitions can be delayed, occasionally leaving spatial gaps during quick opponent counter-offensive shifts. Due to her moderate physical frame and top-end sprint speed, her capacity to outmuscle physically dominant opposition midfielders in high-impact ground duels or drive long distances with the ball remains naturally capped. Combining her tactical intelligence, reliable ball retention, and high-level structural discipline, she is well-suited to serve as a starting XI player for an lower-table team within a professional league or as a starting XI player for an upper-table team within a semi-professional league
